definitions.gloss: knob (a round handle on a door, drawer, or appliance)
definitions.explanation: A round handle that one turns or pulls — most commonly a door knob, but also drawer knobs and tuning knobs on devices.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ノブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}した→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
ノブ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The knob broke, so I had it fixed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ノブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧⟦{握|にぎ}って→握る：02383_nigiru⟧、⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: I gently grasped the cold metal knob and opened the door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドアノブ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The doorknobs in the old house were made of ceramic, giving the place a unique atmosphere.

notes:
ノブ is a loanword from English "knob," referring to a round, gripping handle that is turned or pulled. By far the most common usage is for door knobs (ドアノブ).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ノブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to turn a knob
- ノブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to grip a knob
- ノブ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧: a knob breaks
- ドアノブ: doorknob (very frequent compound)
- ボリュームノブ: volume knob (on audio equipment)
- ガスコンロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ノブ: gas-stove control knob

USAGE:
- ノブ alone is most often understood as ドアノブ unless the context suggests otherwise.
- Traditional Japanese homes often used ⟦{取|と}っ{手|て}→取っ手：24070_totte⟧ (lever-style or sliding handles) rather than knobs; ノブ is associated more with Western-style doors.

RELATED WORDS:
- ドアノブ: doorknob
- ⟦{取|と}っ{手|て}→取っ手：24070_totte⟧: handle (general — includes knobs, lever handles, suitcase handles, etc.)
- ⟦ハンドル→ハンドル：06331_handoru⟧: handle (often used for steering wheels and lever-style handles)
- {把手|はしゅ} / {把手|とって}: handle (more formal/written term)

SCOPE NOTE:
- The English word "knob" can also mean "a small lump" or carry slang/vulgar meanings in British English. Japanese ノブ has only the handle/control sense and is neutral in register.
